Summary
: The English translation of the Jnaneshwari (Dnyaneshwari), a Marathi commentary on the Bhagavad Gita from the 13th century written by Jnaneshwar (Sri Jnanadev). The Bhagavad Gita embodies the essence of the Vedic Religion and this commentary (also known as the Bhavartha Dipika) brings to light the idden significance and deeper meaning of the conversations embedded in the Gita.
Alternative titles: Jñāneśvarī (ज्ञानेश्वरी), Jñāneśwarī, Jnaneshvari, Jnanesvari, Jnaneswari, Jñānēśvarī, Bhāvārthadīpikā (भावार्थदीपिका), Bhāvārtha-dīpikā (भावार्थ-दीपिका), Deepika, Bhavarthadipika.
